app.title: Capital Growth Tracker
app.subtitle: Plan your trades and project compound growth on the NYSE calendar.
table.rows: {count, plural, =0 {No periods} one {# period} other {# periods}}
lang.label: Language
controls.scheduleHelp: Weeks run Monday–Sunday. Trades are spread across NYSE open days, starting with the first session; several may fall on one day. Holidays redistribute the weekly quota. Partial weeks include only scheduled trades within your dates. Both dates are included. Up to 4,000 trades.
schedule.total: {count, plural, one {# planned trade} other {# planned trades}}
schedule.empty: No trades are scheduled within this range. Extend the dates or increase trades per week.
validation.dates: Choose a valid date range between 2000 and 2100, with the end on or after the start.
validation.weekly: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100 trades per week.
validation.count: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max} trades.
validation.limit: This range exceeds {max} trades. Shorten the range or reduce trades per week.
validation.horizon: The schedule extends beyond 2100. Choose an earlier start, fewer trades or more trades per week.
validation.capital: Enter a valid initial investment and profit per trade.
validation.overflow: This projection is too large to calculate. Reduce the profit per trade or the number of trades.
table.label: Capital projection
table.scrollHint: Scroll the table horizontally to see all columns.
